label: Выше
description: A 10-sentence usage card for выше (higher, above).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Comparative direction. 'Выше' is the comparative of высоко, marking a higher position. It modifies 'подними', telling how much further up to move the picture.
Strategic focus: Comparison of height. 'Выше' here takes the genitive 'гор', marking the clouds as positioned above the mountains. It states a static relative location higher than something.
Strategic focus: Superlative-like comparison. 'Выше' with the genitive 'всех птиц' marks the eagle flying above every other bird. It names the highest relative position in flight.
Strategic focus: One level up. 'Выше' marks a position higher than the current one, here one floor up. The instrumental 'этажом' measures the difference in height.
Strategic focus: Rising ever higher. 'Выше' marks an increasingly high position, modifying 'поднимается'. The 'всё' stresses a continuous rise to a greater height.
Strategic focus: Relative placement. 'Выше' takes the genitive 'окна', marking the shelf as positioned above the window. It states where to hang it, higher than a reference point.
Strategic focus: Encouraging greater height. 'Выше' modifies 'прыгай', urging a jump that reaches higher than before. It marks a comparative degree of upward motion.
Strategic focus: Above a reference point. 'Выше' takes the genitive 'облаков', marking the plane as positioned above the clouds. It names a static relative height after the climb.
Strategic focus: Directing the gaze higher. 'Выше' marks a higher target for looking, modifying 'смотри'. It tells the listener to raise the eyes to a greater height.
Strategic focus: Explicit comparison. 'Выше' here pairs with 'чем' to compare the mountain's height against the hill. The construction marks one thing as positioned higher than another.
